reason: A gives me what I look for to tell a teacher apart from someone who can work in a regulated plant: signed training records, two clean state audits, a cut from 20 to 12 training hours, a GMP course already underway and a clear start date. It is also addressed to me by name. B has generic placeholders and only a vague promise to learn records and GMP quickly, which is exactly the kind of teacher application I expect.
